description: Every UniFi Network API operation, plus drift detection, topology, and rule prediction no other UniFi tool has.

novel_features.name: Device topology tree
novel_features.description: See the physical device tree (gateway to switches to APs) built entirely from local mirror data, no live crawl needed.

novel_features.name: Config drift detection
novel_features.description: Show what changed in site config (networks, firewall, wifi, DNS) since the last sync snapshot.

novel_features.name: Newcomer detection
novel_features.description: List devices and clients first seen since a given sync, for spotting new hardware joining the network.

novel_features.name: Port audit
novel_features.description: Review port utilization and PoE status across every switch on a site in one table.

novel_features.name: Guest network report
novel_features.description: Summarize guest network usage: active vouchers and connected guest clients, from local data.

novel_features.name: Firewall rule prediction
novel_features.description: Predict which firewall policy would match a hypothetical packet before making a live change.
